tools.description: Ingest a document: write a doc node + one chunk node per chunk (each derived_from the doc).

source.description: provenance, e.g. a file path or URL

tools.name: knowledge.ingest

tools.description: Write ONE knowledge node (doc/section/chunk/concept). Returns its stable id.
tools.name: knowledge.write

tools.description: Add ONE TYPED relation (Other("<rel>") edge) between two existing node ids, with confidence + provenance. Both endpoints must have a live node (else isError).

rel.description: the relation type, e.g. governs, refines, contradicts

tools.name: knowledge.relate

tools.description: Standalone recall: the most relevant token-budgeted knowledge slice for a query (keyword ∪ vector, RRF-fused).
tools.name: knowledge.recall

tools.description: Coverage: node counts (optionally per class) and the count of logged recall misses (gap-hunting input).
tools.name: knowledge.coverage

tools.description: Cross-store link: mark a knowledge node as `about` one or more code symbols (estate symbol ids), so recall can surface it FROM those code seeds even with zero lexical overlap.

code_ids.description: estate code symbol ids this knowledge is about

knowledge_id.description: the knowledge node id returned by knowledge.write / knowledge.ingest

tools.name: knowledge.relate_code

tools.description: The cross-store differentiator: recall the knowledge linked (`about`) to one or more code symbols — surfaces grounding docs FROM a code seed across the SEPARATE knowledge store, no keyword overlap needed.

code_ids.description: estate code symbol ids to recall knowledge about

tools.name: knowledge.recall_about_code
